candidates.subject: John 1:38-39 invitation to Andrew and the unnamed disciple
candidates.likeness: Strong recognizable consistency with approved reference: dark wavy shoulder-length hair, brow and nose structure, warm brown eyes, full dark beard and similar facial proportions. More restrained expression and three-quarter angle fit an invitation. Not a pixel-identical or owner-approved derivative.
candidates.pupils_gaze: Visible pupils look coherent and naturally directed toward the listeners; no evident crossed or malformed eyes.
candidates.age_expression: Adult Christ and adult male listeners are plausible. Warm, attentive expression fits the invitation; no incongruous broad grin.
candidates.anatomy: Open inviting hand has plausible thumb and finger arrangement; listener's visible hand and all visible limbs show no evident extra digits or broken anatomy. Some finger overlap is normal perspective.
candidates.event_specificity: Three men and an inviting gesture fit the passage, but do not uniquely establish this event without caption. Keep second disciple unnamed; do not relabel this as calling Peter and Andrew from fishing.
candidates.setting: Stone buildings, earth path, olive foliage and woven clothing form a plausible artistic ancient setting. Particular village, dwelling, clothing colors and exact position are artistic choices, not documented details of John 1:38-39.
candidates.required_caption_boundary: Identify as an artistic depiction of Jesus inviting Andrew and another disciple to come and see; distinguish imagined setting from the recorded invitation.
